messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: HMecology email list is being re-tasked
parts:
Dear all,
 The HMecology email list is being re-tasked as a discussion and help list to support hierarchical modeling in ecology.
 While the unmarked list will continue to be used solely for support of the unmarked package, we expect that HMecology will adopt a broader perspective and deal with Bayesian analysis, BUGS/JAGS and other things which are off-limits to unmarked.
 
 In addition, Marc Kery and I are finishing a book project called Applied Hierarchical Modeling and this email list will handle general questions related to that material when the book is published.

 If you don't want on this list or want to change your settings to not receive every post you can sign in and click a few buttons or something.

regards
andy
